verdicts.explanation: The news pages show their date only as plain text (e.g. 'Preview — Sep 15, 2025'); their JSON-LD is typed Organization/PostalAddress, not an article type carrying datePublished, so no machine-readable date exists.
The homepage's search-toggle button contains only an aria-hidden SVG icon and no text, aria-label or title, so it exposes no accessible name to assistive tech or a non-visual agent.
